payload.name: pc-check-timeout-ms
payload.description: Pure-logic validation of a raw timeout value. Returns valid=true only for an exact integer in 0..7500 inclusive; returns valid=false with timeout_ms=null for missing, null, bool, float, non-integer or out-of-range values. No exceptions, no coercion, no host calls, no imports, no I/O.
payload.content:
# Target typed-input interface; binding validates the raw candidate before any effect.
timeout_ms = inputs.get("timeout_ms")
valid = isinstance(timeout_ms, int) and not isinstance(timeout_ms, bool) and 0 <= timeout_ms <= 7500
result = {"valid": valid, "timeout_ms": timeout_ms if valid else None}
